backend/main.mo: Motoko actor managing user profiles and fuel fill-ups with access control, storing total fuel cost and mileage data.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old fill-up entries to include totalFuelCost with default value.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing frontend files, components, and tests related to total fuel cost and price-per-liter updates.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend files describing their roles in UI, logic, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/ANDROID.md: Guide for building and deploying the Android TWA wrapper, including setup, authentication, and release steps.
frontend/android/.gitignore: Gitignore rules for Android project artifacts, configs, and build outputs.
frontend/android/app/build.gradle: Android Gradle configuration defining build settings, dependencies, and compile targets for the TWA app.
frontend/android/app/src/main/AndroidMan: Manifest configuring TWA launcher activity, host restrictions, authentication redirects, and splash screen metadata.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/drawab: XML defining splash screen background and centered splash image.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/mipmap: Adaptive launcher icon referencing background and foreground drawables.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/values: Color resources for primary theme, background, and splash screen.
String resources for app name and configurable canister host URLs.
App theme definitions including splash screen styling for TWA.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/xml/fi: FileProvider path configuration allowing cache directory access.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/xml/ne: Network security configuration enforcing HTTPS and trusting system certificates for IC domains.
frontend/android/app/src/main/res/xml/sh: Placeholder XML for optional app shortcuts.
frontend/android/bubblewrap.json: Defines TWA configuration for the Android wrapper, including app metadata, icons, manifest URL, and SDK settings.
frontend/android/build.gradle: Sets global Gradle repositories and configures the Android build plugin with a clean task.
frontend/android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-w: Specifies Gradle wrapper distribution settings using Gradle 8.0.
frontend/android/README.md: Overview of the Android TWA wrapper, configuration steps, prerequisites, and build instructions.
frontend/android/settings.gradle: Names the root project and includes the app module.
frontend/index.css: Configures Tailwind and defines light/dark theme CSS variables with base styling.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file loading the React app, manifest, icons, and registering the service worker.
frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.j: Declares Android Digital Asset Links for TWA URL handling verification.
frontend/public/manifest.json: Defines PWA metadata including name, colors, start URL, and app icons.
frontend/public/offline.html: Static offline fallback page shown when the app cannot load due to no network.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker handling caching, offline behavior, and asset pre-caching for the PWA.
frontend/PWA.md: Guide for verifying PWA installability and testing service worker and offline behavior.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component managing authentication flow, profile setup, and dashboard rendering.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button handling Internet Identity auth and cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Dashbo: Displays mileage stats, fill-up form, filters, and filtered fill-up history.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/FillUp: Renders a list of fill-up entries with formatted metrics and loading/empty states.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Filter: UI controls for selecting date range and sort order of fill-up history.
frontend/src/components/fillups/FillUpFo: Provides a dialog form for submitting new fill-up entries with validation, unit conversion, and actor readiness checks.
frontend/src/components/fillups/MileageS: Displays average, best, worst efficiency and total distance based on fill-up data, adapting output to the user’s unit system.
frontend/src/components/help/HelpContent: Shows instructional text explaining how mileage is calculated along with tips and definitions of stats.
Wraps HelpContent in a modal dialog triggered by a help button.
Provides the main application layout with header, footer, and shared UI actions like help, login, and install.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Onboa: Renders the onboarding experience with hero content, feature descriptions, and login/install actions.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal dialog for creating a user profile with name and unit system selection.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallAppBu: Shows an install button when the PWA is installable and triggers the browser install prompt.
frontend/src/features/dashboard/filterin: Provides date-range filtering and timestamp-based sorting for fill-up entries, including handling of invalid timestamps.
frontend/src/features/fillups/dateTime.t: Validates timestamps and formats them into readable locale date/time strings.
frontend/src/features/fillups/types.ts: Defines types for fill-up entries and form data, including computed fields like efficiency and price per liter.
frontend/src/features/fillups/useFillUps: React Query hooks to fetch, transform, sort, compute derived fields for fill-ups, and submit new fill-up data.
frontend/src/features/fillups/validation: Validates fill‑up form input fields with numeric and logical checks, returning structured errors.
frontend/src/features/profile/useUserPro: React Query hooks for fetching and saving the caller’s user profile and role via the backend actor.
Manages PWA install prompts, tracking installability and triggering installation when possible.
frontend/src/features/units/units.ts: Provides unit labels and formatting utilities for distance, fuel, and efficiency across metric and imperial systems.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance using Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context, handling login, stored identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file indicating that queries reside in feature-specific hooks.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS setup and custom light/dark theme variables for the app's design system.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with Internet Identity and React Query providers and renders the root component.
frontend/src/utils/actorError.ts: Parses unknown actor call errors into a user-facing message and structured console details. Handles common rejection patterns and avoids exposing sensitive information.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters, persist them in sessionStorage, and clean them from hash-based routing. Supports fallback between URL and session for state retention.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with extended color tokens, container settings, custom animations, and plugin integrations. Defines theme extensions for UI elements, charts, and layout styling.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, existing features, and pending feature requests for adding price-per-liter functionality. Defines schema versioning and project state details.
